borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: Variation to Condition 2 (Drawings) of planning permission 2021/03898/FUL granted 27th August 2025 for redevelopment of Albert and Swedish Wharf.Removal of the following: Condition 21 (Deliveries and Collections), Condition 56 (Refuse), and Condition 70 (Zero Emission Delivery Hub).Amendments to following: Wording of Condition 75 (Fire Strategy) to update consultant report/name. Wording of Condition 77 (Number of Residential Units) to update the number of residential units. Condition 82 (London Heliport - Cranes and aviation lighting) to update reference to building heights. Condition 84 (Thames Flood Deference) to update drawing number and wording to reference replacement and/or upgrade of river wall/flood defence.See PDF for full description.
